proof_body:
by
  intro T _ f ε hε
  have hc : f ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fourier (T := T)))).topologicalClosure := by
    rw [span_fourier_closure_eq_top]; trivial
  have hc' : f ∈ closure ((Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fourier (T := T))) : Submodule ℂ C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) : Set C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]; exact hc
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hd⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hc' ε hε
  obtain ⟨c, hc2⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp).mp hg
  refine ⟨c.support, c, fun x => ?_⟩
  have e : ∑ k ∈ c.support, c k * fourier k x = g x := by
    rw [← hc2, Finsupp.sum, ContinuousMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    rfl
  rw [e]
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt ((f - g).norm_coe_le_norm x) hd
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ), ∀ x : AddCircle T, ‖f x - ∑ k ∈ s, a k * fourier k x‖ < ε
